name: Disocclusion Headlight
summary: Selection assistance in VR that makes objects in front of the target transparent within a 'headlight' cone, revealing hidden targets.
howItWorks: A cone of view from the user's head renders occluding objects semi-transparent, so the user can see and point at a target that was hidden behind them.
